text: The independent verifier sees the satellite records, the repair record, documents and measurements. Server-side checks confirm complete documentation, an authorised provider, independent parties, consistent timestamps, files matching the on-chain hash, and a reduction beyond measurement uncertainty.
The reduction counts documented monitoring hours only, times the IPCC AR6 warming potential, and it's labelled synthetic. A later satellite pass that sees no plume is never proof.
The verifier signs an EIP-712 message bound to this project, evidence hash and round. Rejected or inconclusive decisions never pay out, and old signatures can't be replayed.
